author: "Stanley Chhatwal"

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(rhinovirus))

# I have selected the dataset Rhiovirus and used the head commans to ensure only the first 10 rows are visible so there is not too much data to visualise

ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) + 
geom_line() +
ggtitle("Rhinovirus by Year") +
xlab("year") +
ylab("Incidence of Disease") 

```
